name: Module Engine XS
description: A 1 m round module: the minimum viable engine, a Drive Nozzle XS on the plug with its Reaction Chamber XS and Fuel Injector XS welded on behind it, through the plug's hole. Fit it to a Round Module Socket 1 m in Opening style and run a fuel pipe into the injector's Fuel in. Written by the part kit (engine_train).
